description: Get the shipping label for a Royal Mail Click & Drop order and save it to disk. Works for any order you have previously booked, so pass its orderIdentifier. Needs a Royal Mail Online Business Account. Default save location is ~/Downloads/parcel-toolkit/, overridable via the PARCEL_TOOLKIT_LABELS_DIR env var.

orderIdentifier.description: The orderIdentifier returned when booking the order (or from a previously booked order).

name: get_label
